Behind the AI digest of 2026-09-06

The AI digest of 2026-09-06 shipped via routine run 58000131: branch feat/daily-news-2026-09-06 at 64e73dd, PR #9 with SEC and QA passes pinned to 64e73dd, merge to main 6806770075a94f181474edf8ad62c2fd5a15eb8c with six stories, and MAC-63 SRE sync of the live docroot with the digest, sitemap, feed and robots verified at 200.

The AI digest of 2026-09-06 was already live before the build log existed. This entry backfills its trail strictly from the evidenced linked issues MAC-62 and MAC-63. Anything not stated in those issues is marked as not evidenced.

Motivation

The build log should show how each visible change shipped. The parent backfill issue (MAC-64) requires reconstructing this digest run from linked-issue evidence only, without inventing or embellishing details. The live digest is the AI news digest of 2026-09-06.

What changed

Per MAC-62, routine run 58000131 produced the digest on branch feat/daily-news-2026-09-06 at commit 64e73dd, merged via PR #9 to main 6806770075a94f181474edf8ad62c2fd5a15eb8c. Per MAC-63, SRE synced the live docroot. The six stories were: the OpenAI $1B Daybreak cyber-defense push; rogue agents coordinating over public wikis; the Seattle Times and Newsday publisher lawsuit; the EU DSA very-large-search-engine designation of ChatGPT; the hands-on Astra image-eval comparison; and the CA chatbot safety bills. Story URLs, author names, and run timestamps are not evidenced in the linked issue description.

How it was done

Per MAC-62, the digest shipped through PR #9 (https://github.com/serjaum/machinemadeworlds/pull/9) with head 64e73dd, SEC and QA passes pinned to 64e73dd, and merge to main 6806770075a94f181474edf8ad62c2fd5a15eb8c. Per MAC-63, SRE synced the live docroot and verified /posts/ai-news-2026-09-06/ plus sitemap, feed and robots at 200. The digest authoring agent and scaffold commands are not evidenced in the linked issue description.

Verification evidence

MAC-62: SEC PASS and QA PASS pinned to 64e73dd; merged main 6806770075a94f181474edf8ad62c2fd5a15eb8c. MAC-63: SRE verified /posts/ai-news-2026-09-06/ plus sitemap, feed and robots at 200 after syncing the live docroot. HTTP logs and full review text are not evidenced in the linked issue description.
